features.title: Composable sections
features.body: Hero, Feature Cards, Quote, FAQ, and CTA — each fetches and renders only its own fields.

features.title: SEO + sitemap
features.body: Per-page metadata, Open Graph cards, canonical URLs, robots, sitemap, and JSON-LD.

features.title: Live preview
features.body: Edit in the Presentation tool with click-to-edit overlays and instant updates.

title: Welcome
seoDescription: A seeded demo page built entirely from typed page-builder sections.

pageBuilder.heading: Build pages from typed sections
pageBuilder.subheading: This page was seeded with `pnpm seed`. Open it in the Studio and rearrange the sections.

features.title: Typed section registry
features.body: Each section co-locates its schema, GROQ projection, and renderer — they can't drift apart.

features.title: SEO out of the box
features.body: Per-page metadata, Open Graph and Twitter cards, sitemap, robots, and JSON-LD.

features.title: Live + ISR caching
features.body: Instant updates via the Live Content API with an ISR baseline and tag revalidation.

pageBuilder.heading: Ready to build?
pageBuilder.body: Add or edit a section in the Studio and watch this page update.

title: About
seoDescription: How this page-builder example is put together.

pageBuilder.heading: One source of truth per side
pageBuilder.subheading: The Studio config and the frontend registry each describe the sections once; the packages do the wiring.

pageBuilder.quote: Add a section in five small steps and it appears in the insert menu, fetches its own fields, and renders on the frontend.
pageBuilder.author: The README

items.question: How do I add a new section?
items.answer: Follow the "Adding a new section" steps in the README — schema, preview, component, block type, and a registry entry.

items.question: Does it support nested paths?
items.answer: Yes — the route is a catch-all. See the seeded /docs/getting-started page.

title: Getting Started
seoDescription: A page served from a nested catch-all path.

pageBuilder.heading: This page lives at a nested path
pageBuilder.subheading: Its slug is `docs/getting-started`, served by the `/[...slug]` catch-all route.

pageBuilder.heading: Three steps to your first page

features.title: 1. Create a Page
features.body: In the Studio, add a Page and give it a title and slug.

features.title: 2. Add sections
features.body: Use the insert menu's visual grid to drop in Hero, Feature Cards, Quote, FAQ, or CTA sections.

features.title: 3. Publish
features.body: Publish, then visit the page at its slug to see it render.
